references.text: Describes how the army of Israel treated Jericho and its king, which is directly referenced in Joshua 10:30
The same pattern of conquest and complete destruction of Makkedah and its king, which occurred just before the conquest of Libnah
Shows the same pattern of the Lord delivering the city into Israel's hand, and that all inhabitants were struck with the sword
The same wording that no survivors were left, part of the same military campaign
Moses' command to strike down the enemies and show them no mercy, which is the basis for Joshua's actions
God's command not to let anything that breathes remain alive in the Canaanite cities, which Joshua follows here
The Lord's promise to give Ai and its king into Israel's hand, the same pattern as with Libnah
